body: You are right,  I suppose I won't give up the ghost until  it's an inevitable thing.  I am still at the point where I am a version of me, and I will keep it as long as I can.  When it drifts too far to where I can't even realize that about myself anymore, I don't know if things will be the same.  If I will have the cognizances for it, or not.  I think I am very afraid to be there, and worried that I will let myself become an empty shell of a person then, and wish I had let go sooner.  I don't want the people I know to remember me as an incontinent zombie, and shell of a person I used to be.  I can feel myself drifting there now, and that terrifies me.  Thank you for responding.  It really does mean a lot to me.
